Landed · 2026-11-09T08:27Z — PR #31805 merged through the merge queue (merge commit ef194d7977). The maintainer enqueued it after the seat's Tier H ACCEPT 6732766165.

- In `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the `subflow` row now teaches how a bare `config.flowName` resolves. A package's flow resolves to its own flow, else to the one holder in its `dependencies` closure plus `sys`. A package-less flow resolves to the environment's flow, else to the one package holder. Otherwise the node fails at run time naming every candidate (`outside-closure`, `ambiguous-in-closure`, `ambiguous-in-environment`), and `os validate` does not catch it. The `map` row points at the `subflow` row and says a refused name fails at the first item.
- Eval case 20 is in flows-triggers-approvals. The ceiling went 6527 → 6568 under standing ruling 6513306068 letter B, after nine restatement cuts.

`pm:dispatched` removed. Nothing left on this card.
